For a 50-person Indian company, published all-in managed-service prices are generally quote-based, so I would shortlist these and demand a written per-trip fee schedule before paying:

Offer	Current cost	Key terms to verify
MakeMyTrip myBiz	₹0 platform fee advertised; travel charged at booking	Flight/hotel mark-ups, cancellation/date-change fees, GST invoice eligibility, human support SLA. 
MakeMyTrip Business

FCM Travel India	Custom quote	Transaction/service fees, 24/7 support coverage, implementation fee, cancellation/reissue charges, hotel-rate savings, contract exit terms. 
FCM Travel
+1

American Express BTA + TMC	Custom TMC pricing; BTA consolidates air spend	TMC booking fees, credit/payment terms, insurance exclusions, foreign-transaction charges, eligibility, reconciliation fees. Amex advertises up to 51 days payment extension. 
American Express

Before paying: require a 12-month total-cost example covering 50 employees, domestic + international flights, hotels, cancellations/reissues, GST, implementation, support, and exit fees. That makes the offers genuinely comparable.
